description: a 10 cube written by Open CASCADE whose top front edge, its two vertices and its line, are lifted 1.3e-7 off the top face's plane in the file — the shape of NIST FTC-06's (AP242 e2, solid #7516) two plane-against-plane edges at (76.2, 52.07, −15.875) and (−88.9, 52.07, −15.875), whose lines lie 1.27e-7 off a face they bound — that edge filleted at r 1: two planes, convex, the blend a quarter cylinder. Arris faults with Internal(Geometry(NotOnSurface)) where the edge's tolerance covers what the faces' does not (plans/c6-blend-pairs step 3, found by the blend census)
